design_rule: Extend existing Type-I VGK/CIM kernels with reusable typed domain associations; never replace original owner workbook, Object_ID, source bytes, model parameter qualification or signed DBR.

source_anchors.authority: existing owner Type-I VGK workbook mirrored source
existing owner component interaction map mirrored source

semantic_contract.identity: Existing Object_ID belongs to custodian, not inferred from shared operator, name or frequency
requirements: original R0 source ref and hash
semantic_contract.view_lens: Existing Generative UI and Alexandria source lens; only ACL-qualified objects hydrated; show Source / Equation / Regime / Limit / Consequence / Required Test / Verdict
semantic_contract.fractal_rule: Typed repeated motifs and reusable graph edges may reduce duplicated schemas; no claim of physically higher dimensions, universal lossless semantic compression, new energy source or automatically trained model.

operators.name: Mass/momentum transport and constitutive viscosity
operators.governing: Continuity, momentum conservation, constitutive stress; Poiseuille only for fully developed Newtonian steady incompressible laminar circular flow

domains.name: PrintSpace feed or resin
domains.qualification: viscosity vs temperature/shear/cure, wall/thermal/chemical stage, pressure and bubble limits

domains.name: M1 corridor mist and environmental flow
domains.qualification: two-phase droplet size, wind, deposition, public/environment safety and local CFD/measurement

domains.name: hydrology and ecological remediation
domains.qualification: sediment/contaminant transport, chemistry, ecological/erosion response and data fidelity

domains.name: microgravity fluid storage
domains.qualification: wetting, free surface/capillary/buoyancy balance; terrestrial pressure-flow calibration not an orbital test

operators.falsifier: Re regime, measured pressure-flow mismatch, non-Newtonian shear or compressibility invalidates reduced law

operators.name: Passive electromagnetic scattering, spectroscopy and intercepted energy
operators.governing: Maxwell fields, antenna effective aperture, radiative scattering and Poynting energy balance

domains.name: passive environmental and solar-spectrum sensing
domains.qualification: radiometric calibration, spectral sensitivity, range/attenuation, polarization and line-of-sight

domains.name: RF rectenna or resonator
domains.qualification: incident site spectrum, effective aperture, rectification efficiency, matching and calibrated input-output

domains.name: remote backscatter/echo
domains.qualification: illumination source, radar/sonar link budget, target cross-section, noise and receiver sensitivity

operators.falsifier: Any passive load power exceeding intercepted incident power invalid; echo does not mean energy travelling outward is globally captured

operators.name: Acoustic and electromagnetic observation vs actuation
operators.governing: Wave propagation/scattering with finite transmitter/ambient illumination and receiver noise; acoustic vs EM media must not be conflated

domains.name: sonar in supported physical medium
domains.qualification: acoustic impedance, sound speed/attenuation, medium temperature, scattering geometry and Doppler

domains.name: passive RF observation
domains.qualification: external transmitter/solar/natural ambient illumination, antenna chain, calibration and spectral attribution

domains.name: Schumann resonance studies
domains.qualification: very-low-frequency cavity modes of Earth-ionosphere, antenna and field measurement; not a proven broadband communication or harvest backbone

operators.falsifier: No medium-specific wave speed, calibrated source/illumination or SNR budget means no derived sensing coverage

operators.name: Particle, debris and orbital transfer with environmental custody
operators.governing: Mass/momentum/kinetic-energy conservation with orbit dynamics, collision probability, deposition and chemical/thermal fate as independent submodels

domains.name: orbital debris Luke II mitigation concept
domains.qualification: conjunction risk, navigation/trajectory, momentum exchanges, capture or disposal physics, debris safety and regulatory review

domains.name: asteroid regolith / resource separation
domains.qualification: particle size/composition/surface binding/thermal energy, dust loss and controlled recovery

domains.name: tailored celestial body or ice deposition
domains.qualification: very-long-horizon hypothesis: orbital capture/delta-v, impact heating/fragmentation, volatile sublimation, tidal/gravity, contamination and environmental regime; no passive self-absorption assumption

operators.falsifier: Nonzero relative impact energy, unbound trajectory, high dispersion or uncontrolled debris invalidates passive aggregation story

operators.name: Micro-macro geometry and assembly interfaces
operators.governing: Scale-dependent geometry/topology graph and independently defined port, material and state transitions; conservation does not imply material identity

domains.name: PrintSpace three-head 4D seed assembly
domains.qualification: collision swept volume, material X→Y sequence, cure, atmosphere and encapsulation

domains.name: CGX modular node/robotic chain
domains.qualification: source-qualified interface/port identity, kinematics, stiffness, heat transfer and power budget

domains.name: interplanetary chain resource nodes
domains.qualification: orbital frame, freight/delta-v, custody, independent connector and thermal/structural evidence

operators.falsifier: Bit, joule, kilogram and component identity are not convertible as one conserved quantity or same physical entity

operators.name: Loss, residual and evidence-grade ledger for cross-domain adapters
operators.governing: Explicit balance of domain-specific conserved quantities, uncertainties, source/sink terms and unobserved losses

domains.name: environmental ecology and waste
domains.qualification: material composition toxicity/mobility, ecological flux boundary, assay uncertainty and response

domains.name: energy/storage/communications
domains.qualification: P_in, P_out, storage/heat/radiation losses, time integration and receiver SNR

domains.name: CGX retrieval, semantic and GenUI
domains.qualification: R0 content hash/rights/ACL preserved; R1/R2 inference, lossy compression and human acceptance recorded separately

operators.falsifier: A residual cannot be claimed zero without measurement/source receipts, and loss in information is not equivalent to joule loss

bounded_test_contracts.check: Newtonian cylindrical laminar law pressure delta and Reynolds dimensionless bound; independent non-Newtonian regime rejection
Intercepted passive RF power no greater than incident irradiance times effective aperture and efficiencies ≤1
Nonzero debris encounter energy for relative speed; cannot assert zero-energy orbital capture
Balance residual nonzero when supplied loss is excluded; do not automatically claim measured efficiency
Conserved physical dimensions remain distinct from bit-count and type labels

frontier_held.next: GMAT/other orbital dynamics + impact/thermal + capture and safety receipts before any feasibility claim
Measure incident spectral flux and antenna/polarisation/rectifier to establish physically available power
Actual spectral/SNR/propagation/throughput/power measurements, no global data-service inference
Separately prove active source or passive illumination, path loss, atmospheric/medium response and SNR

frontier_held.candidate: Type-I scale equivalence between bit, joule, resource node
frontier_held.next: Keep mathematical graph analogy separate from dimensional conservation and material device qualification
Actual opt-in owner and lawful authority, accepted native peers and #161; no other country access automatically granted
